svg.text: Step 1: Webhook Trigger & Guardrail Check - Ingests webhook events from GitHub/GitLab when a
PR is marked 'Ready for Review', verifying branch permissions and token expenditure
Step 2: AST-Filtered Diff Extraction - Parses repository changes using Abstract Syntax Tree
(AST) analysis to filter out cosmetic changes and isolate logic paths and security-sensitive
Step 3: Vulnerability & Bug Remediation Generation - Feeds filtered diff context and
security rules into an AI remediation engine to construct code patches and explanatory
Step 4: Sandbox Provisioning & Patch Application - Spawns a secure, ephemeral microVM or
container sandbox and applies the candidate patch on top of the target branch.
Step 5: Test Suite Verification - Executes the repository's native test suites (unit,
integration, linting) within the sandbox to ensure zero regressions or broken tests.
Step 6: PR Feedback & Suggested Commit Delivery - Packages verified patches into suggested
commits or review comments with inline explanations detailing the fix and test outcomes.
Step 7: Human Verification & Sign-off - Halts execution at the mandatory human-in-the-loop
gate, requiring manual review and merge authorization with strict prohibitions against
